prompt_en: Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original K-pop-idol-inspired woman in her mid-twenties with a distinct fictional face. The casting is an original adult fashion model. She has luminous porcelain-pale skin and long glossy dark hair, a slender athletic silhouette with a visible thigh gap, and wears a deep-cobalt high-waisted, full-coverage sporty bikini. She stands barefoot at a bright ocean waterline, her body remaining a clear rear view, arms relaxed naturally. Use a balanced vertical full-figure frame from a low camera position behind her at knee height. Place both feet close and parallel, keeping a finger-width separation at the upper inner thighs. Her legs stay softly adducted with the knees close. The actual upper inner-thigh contours form clean opposing boundaries. A narrow inverted-triangle background opening is clearly visible between the upper inner thighs. The appealing focal geometry is deliberately readable within the full figure; the opening comes from the actual upper inner-thigh contours, not shadow. Keep this narrow opening clearly readable at thumbnail scale. Warm late-afternoon sunlight outlines her hair, shoulders, and calves; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon complete the polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling. Render authentic skin texture and confident natural posture.
